document.title: English as a global language
document.question:
English has become the main language of international business, science and the internet. Some welcome this as a way of bringing people together, while others fear that it gives native speakers an unfair advantage and threatens other languages.

Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
